criteria.name: NFR Coverage & Technical Mechanisms
criteria.description: Every NFR- from the PRD is addressed by an explicit named architectural mechanism in architecture.md, or reported as not met with an engineering rationale.

scale.3: 100% of NFR-s cited and addressed with concrete technical mechanisms.
scale.2: All NFRs covered, but minor lack of detail in one mechanism.
scale.1: One or more NFRs from the PRD omitted or unaddressed.

criteria.name: Capacity Estimation & Arithmetic
criteria.description: Capacity numbers (peak requests/s, storage per year, connections) are calculated from cited PRD numbers with clear arithmetic shown per Chapter 17, selecting a scale tier (T0-T5).

scale.3: Complete arithmetic shown from cited inputs; valid formulas for Peak RPS, storage growth, and scale tier selection.
scale.2: Arithmetic shown but minor calculation or rounding discrepancy.
scale.1: Numbers stated without showing arithmetic from cited inputs.
scale.0: Capacity estimate missing or completely invented.

criteria.name: Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) & Tradeoffs
criteria.description: Every major technical decision has an ADR (ADR-###) comparing at least two real alternatives against constraints, citing the driving NFR- and explaining why alternatives lost.

scale.3: All ADRs include context citing NFR-, at least two real options with tradeoffs, decision, and consequences.
scale.2: ADRs present with alternatives, but one tradeoff description is brief.
scale.1: ADRs lack real alternative comparisons or lack NFR- citations.
scale.0: ADRs missing or decisions made without rationales.

criteria.name: Feature to API & Schema Traceability
criteria.description: Every feature (F-###) maps to at least one endpoint (API-###) in openapi.yaml and at least one database table (TBL-###) in schema.md.

scale.3: 100% of features map directly to corresponding endpoints and tables with explicit ID citations.
scale.2: All features mapped, but minor citation formatting discrepancy.
scale.1: One or more features missing an endpoint or table mapping.

criteria.name: API Design Standards & Error Handling
criteria.description: REST endpoints use plural nouns, explicit authentication and authorization rules, and RFC 9457 Problem Details error models (400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 422, 500).

scale.3: Endpoints specify auth rules, standard REST conventions, and comprehensive error schemas.
scale.2: Endpoints specified with auth, but minor error status code omissions.
scale.1: Missing auth rules or missing error status schemas.
scale.0: Non-compliant API design or missing contracts.

criteria.name: Security Architecture & STRIDE Threat Model
criteria.description: STRIDE threat model (T-##) covers all application entry points with concrete, verifiable mitigations (authentication, authorization, encryption, rate limiting).

scale.3: Comprehensive STRIDE model covering spoofing, tampering, repudiation, information disclosure, DoS, elevation of privilege.
scale.2: Threat model present, but 1-2 threats have generic mitigations.
scale.1: Threat model missing key STRIDE categories or entry points.
scale.0: Security section missing or purely generic.

criteria.name: Grounding & Evidence Verification
criteria.description: Every technical choice, cited constraint, and number is strictly grounded in the PRD or verified discovery log. Zero unprompted tech stack choices without an ADR citing an NFR-.

scale.3: Zero unsupported claims; all cited IDs exist and support the statements; all dependencies verified.
scale.2: Minor citation typo, but all claims grounded.
scale.1: Contains ungrounded claims or tech choices without ADR justification.

criteria.name: Build Order & HR Team Plan
criteria.description: Specifies a thin, testable walking skeleton for early build validation, and provides an HR team plan with role allocations citing F- and ADR-.

scale.3: Clear walking skeleton defined end-to-end, plus structured team plan with role counts and work attribution.
scale.2: Walking skeleton and team plan present, but attribution lacks detail.
scale.1: Walking skeleton vague or team plan omitted.
scale.0: Both walking skeleton and team plan missing.
